member_docstrings: TestAssessmentHashChain: Tests for the SHA-256 tamper-evident audit chain on assessments.
test_insufficient_windows_returns_zero: Score is 0 when fewer than min_windows buckets exist.
test_stable_frequency_low_score: When call counts are stable across windows the z-score is low.
test_spike_produces_high_score: A sudden spike in call frequency should yield a high z-score.
test_unknown_agent_returns_zero: Scoring an agent with no data should return 0.
test_insufficient_actions_returns_none: Entropy is None when too few actions have been recorded.
test_uniform_distribution_high_entropy: Uniform distribution over many distinct actions → high entropy.
test_single_action_zero_entropy: All identical actions → entropy = 0 → anomaly (stuck in loop).
test_erratic_behavior_high_score: Very high entropy (many distinct actions) → positive score.
